trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If I would have known, I would have come.
trap.right: If I had known, I would have come.
trap.why: Em português dizemos “se eu tivesse sabido” mas o brasileiro traduz com would na oração com if. No terceiro condicional: if + had + particípio, would have + particípio.

mcq.q: If I **___** known, I would have come.
If she had studied, she **___** passed.

fix.wrong: If I would have known, I would have come.
fix.right: If I had known, I would have come.

fix.wrong: If he had called, I would answered.
fix.right: If he had called, I would have answered.

fix.wrong: If we had went, we would have seen it.
fix.right: If we had gone, we would have seen it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I didn’t know, so I didn’t come.” (If I…)
rewrite.answer: If I had known, I would have come.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “She didn’t study, so she failed.”
rewrite.answer: If she had studied, she wouldn’t have failed.
